From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Locking a 60-90m ML/Infra deep-dive — next steps & proposed agenda

Hi Emily / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call earlier — really helpful to get a sense of CloudPulse's priorities. Quick recap so we’re aligned before we lock the technical deep-dive with our ML/infra folks: 

- Primary goal: validate performance for your streaming inference use case at 2–3k reqs/min with 100–200 token average responses and confirm cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Constraints: private deployment option (VPC) and SOC 2 evidence needed; data retention policy of 90 days; egress limits across regions.
- Models: you mentioned evaluating both open Llama-family variants and a fine-tuned instruction model.

Next step: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (ML/infra) where we can:
1) walk your infra team through our serving runtime and kernel selection logic,
2) validate capacity planning and GPU sizing for peak windows,
3) review caching/batching strategies and KV cache sizing,
4) discuss quantization and perf/quality tradeoffs, and
5) map out a short proof-of-concept timeline.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jan 19, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jan 20, 09:00–10:30
- Thu Jan 21, 13:00–14:30

If any of those work, tell us which one you prefer and who from your infra/security team will join. I’ve cc’d Ben (solutions) and Lauren (cal) to pull together a focused agenda and send the calendar invite. I attached a short precall notes PDF and a draft agenda (proposed-tdx-agenda.md) — feel free to edit.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0173
Redwood Inference
